This Amendment No. 1 to Form 8-K is an amendment to the Current Report on Form 8-K filed by Halliburton Company on February 23, 2022 concerning the election of Ms. Tobi M. Edwards Young and Mr. Earl M. Cummings as members of our Board of Directors. The sole purpose of this Amendment No. 1 is to disclose the appointments of Ms. Young and Mr. Cummings to certain Committees of the Board.

On May 18, 2022, at a meeting of the Board of Directors, the Board appointed Ms. Young to its Audit and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees and Mr. Cummings to its Audit and Compensation Committees.

This Amendment No. 1 to Form 8-K is an amendment to the Current Report on Form 8-K filed by Halliburton Company on February 23, 2023 concerning the election of Ms. Janet L. Weiss and Mr. Maurice S. Smith as members of our Board of Directors. The sole purpose of this Amendment No. 1 is to disclose the appointments of Ms. Weiss and Mr. Smith to certain Committees of the Board.

On May 17, 2023, at a meeting of the Board of Directors, the Board appointed Ms. Weiss to its Audit and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees and Mr. Smith to its Compensation and Health, Safety and Environment Committees.
